scope: Ten standard products and two duration/month controls; two hash seeds per rules profile; model references are historical, with mixed cache state.
machine: Apple M5 Max workstation; ordinary concurrent desktop use, not isolated hardware benchmarking.

profiles.metadata_only: Rules; initially empty annotation store; pixels and previews only; cache shared serially between routes.
profiles.no_captions: Rules; copied existing classifier/pixel store, all captions, flags and semantic banks removed; Docling v2 backfill; shared preview cache. Not a cold classifier benchmark.
